name: Sandy River Apples/Fenton's Orchard
tagline: Sandy River Apples in Mercer, Maine
description: Sandy River Apples/Fenton's Orchard is a pumpkin patch in Sandy River Road, ME. Visitors come for Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples, best in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from May – Jul in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
